declare
 temp_exp_date date;

begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
--Check for the length of product_code depending on the coding scheme
 IF :global.code_scheme = 'I' and NVL(length( :product_info.product_code), 0) != 8 THEN
 show_error_dist('9803'); -- invalid length of product code for code 128
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :global.code_scheme = 'C' and NVL(length( :product_info.product_code), 0) != 5 THEN
 show_error_dist('9804'); -- invalid length of product code for codabar
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 begin
--Modified for both the schemes to coexist
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 
 end if;
 
 select inv_product_type
 into :product_info.product_type
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_info.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme 
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0309'); -- invalid product code
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in statement 3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 declare
 checked_in exception;
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from active_products ap
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and not exists (select distinct 'x'
 from components
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and component_prefix != ap.aliquot
 and component_status = 'L');
 raise checked_in;

 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from components
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and component_status = 'L'
 and nvl(expiry_date, v_local_time + 1) > v_local_time; -- Added by Kishore on 11/18/2013. IM 9803
 --and nvl(expiry_date, sysdate + 1) > sysdate; -- Commented by Kishore on 11/18/2013. IM 9803

 then
 begin

 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and component_status = 'L';
 show_error_dist('3701');
 check_package_failure;
 exception

 then
 show_error_dist('5327');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 when checked_in
 then
 show_error_dist('5322'); -- Product already checked in
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in statement 3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FOR_INTERDICTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_for_interdictions(p_unit_id in VARCHAR2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_aliquot in number) is
 temp_count number;
 temp_label_dats date;
 temp_label VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 begin
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-1000000), system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 from components
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and component_prefix = p_aliquot;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if product is in quaratine
 --
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from quarantine_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and aliquot = p_aliquot;
 show_error_dist('3728'); -- Product is placed on quarantine
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if product is in discard
 --
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and aliquot = p_aliquot;
 show_error_dist('6300'); -- Product is already discard
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- check for component interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3721'); -- component interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if unit has interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and (vi.inter_type != 'B' or temp_label not in ('40','71'))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3722'); -- unit interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

PROCEDURE Get_base_abo_value (p_actual_blood_type IN varchar2,
 p_base_blood_type OUT varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if (p_actual_blood_type = '71' and :global.code_scheme = 'C') or 
 --Codes for EMERGENCY blood type for code 128
 (p_actual_blood_type in ('92','48','03','59','14','70','25','81','P3','A3','B3','C3','A0','B0','C0','D0','E0','F0','G0','H0') --A0,B0,C0,D0,E0 was added on 04/09/08
 and :global.code_scheme = 'I')
 or p_actual_blood_type = 'PO'
 then
 p_base_blood_type := p_actual_blood_type;
 return;
 end if; 

-- to prevent too many rows error

/* SELECT tested_abo_code
 INTO p_base_blood_type
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = p_actual_blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme; */

 SELECT distinct abo_label
 INTO p_base_blood_type
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only)
 in (SELECT tested_abo_code,abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = p_actual_blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme)
 AND identifier_code = 'RG'
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme ;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error_dist('0300');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
